item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"Admissible intervention requires only online observations and internal state: a decision-relevant ambiguity must remain between competing causal explanations that imply different legal controls, and a bounded control change must permit attribution from subsequent observable outcomes without oracle, trace, benchmark, score, or external-library information. Preserve the champion's unsupported-commitment exclusions and all interface, capacity, uniqueness, integer-key, standard-library, and online-only obligations. Remain observation-conditioned before the trigger; once the trigger is satisfied, select one legal bounded intervention, record its context and outcome using only future accesses, attribute evidence only when the observed change is distinguishable under the controlled transition, and otherwise return to observation-conditioned control.","witnesses":["The visible hypothesis identifies unresolved decision-relevant causes as the sole bottleneck.","The task exposes only one access at a time and requires online-only control.","The contract withholds scores and forbids oracle, trace, benchmark-path, and external-library adaptation.","The anchor already provides a valid policy lineage whose legality and capacity discipline must be retained."],"obligations":["Emit analysis only; do not emit policy source, a patch, a diff, alternatives, or a ranking.","Define the trigger using admissible online evidence rather than unsupported assumptions.","Keep unsupported commitments excluded before and after intervention.","Ensure any downstream intervention remains a legal cache decision, returns only currently cached unique integer keys, and never exceeds capacity.","Use one nonbranching transition from observation-conditioned control to intervention-attributed control, with fallback when attribution is insufficient."],"exact_actions":["Carry this trigger to the final policy call: require unresolved competing causal explanations with decision-relevant divergent actions and a legal bounded intervention whose effects can be evaluated from subsequent online observations.","Instruct the final policy to preserve passive observation until the trigger, apply exactly one controlled transition when triggered, maintain intervention context and outcome internally, and credit the intervention only on attributable evidence.","Instruct the final policy to revert to observation-conditioned control whenever the evidence is confounded, insufficient, unavailable, or inconsistent, without importing hidden information or making unsupported commitments."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
